record.paper_title: Некоторые экстремальные задачи для векторных расслоений
record.original_question: Let a Finsler metric in γ^3_2 mean a continuous choice, in each 2-plane fiber, of a norm depending continuously on the fiber. Must every such Finsler metric have at least one fiber whose unit circle has length exactly 2π, measured in that normed plane?

evidence.quote: Автору неизвестно, верно ли, что для всякой финслеровой метрики в расслоении γ32, т.е. когда в каждом слое задана непрерывно от него зависящая норма, найдется слой, в котором единичная окружность имеет длину 2π.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G_2(\mathbb{R}^3)$ be the Grassmannian of 2-dimensional linear subspaces of $\mathbb{R}^3$, and let $\gamma^3_2 \to G_2(\mathbb{R}^3)$ denote the tautological rank-2 vector bundle whose fiber over a plane $P \in G_2(\mathbb{R}^3)$ is the plane $P$ itself. By a Finsler metric on $\gamma^3_2$ we mean a continuous function $N : \gamma^3_2 \to [0,\infty)$ such that for every $P \in G_2(\mathbb{R}^3)$ the restriction $N|_P$ is a norm on the 2-dimensional vector space $P$. For each fiber $P$, let $S_P = \{v \in P : N(v) = 1\}$ be the unit circle of the corresponding norm, and let $\ell(S_P)$ denote its length as the boundary of a convex symmetric body in the normed plane $(P, N|_P)$, computed using the norm $N|_P$ itself (so the Euclidean unit circle has length $2\pi$).

Question: Must there exist at least one plane $P \in G_2(\mathbb{R}^3)$ such that $\ell(S_P) = 2\pi$?
artifact.status_search_result: No published resolution of this question could be located. The statement is explicitly recorded as not known to the author posing it, and a web search did not reveal a proof or counterexample in the literature on Finsler metrics on tautological bundles over Grassmannians.

status_evidence.title: Finsler geometry of projectivized vector bundles
status_evidence.snippet: General theory of Finsler metrics on vector bundles, no resolution of the specific question.
status_evidence.claim: Background literature on fiberwise Finsler norms on vector bundles does not address the existence of a fiber whose unit circle has length exactly 2π.
